pairs.target: chūfā nàtiān , tǎ wéi fāxiàn ruì shīfu méiyǒu dài yìzhī dàxiāngzǐ .
pairs.english: On departure day, Tavi noticed Master Rui had not brought one large trunk.
pairs.hanzi: 出发那天，塔维发现芮师傅没有带一只大箱子。

pairs.target: tā de dōngxī fēn zài sāngè biǎn xiāng lǐ , yán chē bǎn tiēzhe bǎi , zhòng de yā zài xià tóu , qīng de héngfàng zàizuò hòu . shí yán bǎ tǎ wéi dàilái de jiājù xiāng wǎng pángbiān yì tuī , gěi tā liúchū gē jiǎo de dìfāng .
pairs.english: Her things were divided among three flat cases fitted along the cart boards, heavy ones below, light ones behind the seat. Shiyan pushed Tavi’s fixture crate aside to leave him foot room.
pairs.hanzi: 她的东西分在三个扁箱里，沿车板贴着摆，重的压在下头，轻的横放在座后。石延把塔维带来的夹具箱往旁边一推，给他留出搁脚的地方。

pairs.target: ruì shīfu kàn tā bǎ xíngchéng chāoběn yòu mō le yíbiàn , wèn jiālǐ nà fèn sòngdào le méiyǒu . tā shuō qiántiān sòng qù le , sùshè nà fèn liúzài yīwén shǒulǐ .
pairs.english: Seeing him feel for his itinerary copy again, Master Rui asked whether the home copy had arrived. He said he had delivered it two days earlier and left the dormitory copy with Iven.
pairs.hanzi:
芮师傅看他把行程抄本又摸了一遍，问家里那份送到了没有。
他说前天送去了，宿舍那份留在伊文手里。

pairs.target: tā diǎntóu , ràng tā shàngchē , zìjǐ shēnshǒu bǎ sōngkāi de màodài jié jǐn . màoyán yǒu yídào bǔ xiàn , fēng yì chuī jiù fān qǐ bànbiān , gēn tā běnrén yìdiǎn yě bú kèqì .
pairs.english: She nodded, told him to climb aboard, and tightened her loose hat cord. A repaired seam ran along the brim; every gust flipped half of it up, showing its wearer no courtesy at all.
pairs.hanzi: 她点头，让他上车，自己伸手把松开的帽带结紧。帽沿有一道补线，风一吹就翻起半边，跟她本人一点也不客气。

pairs.target: nài lěi zuòzài qián yíliàng chēshàng . liǎngchē zài chéngmén wài huìhé , tā xiàlái chá guò bǎngshéng , yòu tóng gǎnchē de rén shuō le jǐjùhuà .
pairs.english: Nerai rode in the lead cart. The two carts met outside the city gate; she climbed down to check the bindings and spoke briefly with the drivers.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾坐在前一辆车上。两车在城门外会合，她下来查过绑绳，又同赶车的人说了几句话。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànjiàn tā yāo biān de bái pái lùchū yìjiǎo , shǒumén de rén méi jiào tā pái dào zhuānghuò de duìlǐ , tā què réng děng liǎngliàngchē dōu cháwán cái zǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi saw a corner of the white tally at her waist. The gatekeepers did not send her into the loading queue, but she still waited for both carts to be checked before leaving.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看见她腰边的白牌露出一角，守门的人没叫她排到装货的队里，她却仍等两辆车都查完才走。

pairs.target: xiàshān de lù méiyǒu yán tā shàngcì qù píng mǎtóu de fāngxiàng . chē zài zhòngcài de shíqiáng jiān zhuǎnwān , yuǎnchù de fángdǐng yìcéngcéng tuì dào shēnhòu .
pairs.english: The descent did not follow his earlier route to Flat Landing. The cart turned between vegetable-plot walls, distant rooftops retreating behind them in layers.
pairs.hanzi: 下山的路没有沿他上次去平码头的方向。车在种菜的石墙间转弯，远处的房顶一层层退到身后。

pairs.target: zhōngwǔ guò le yíduàn dī lǐng , hé hūrán cóng zuǒbiān lùchū lái , yánsè bǐ wěi jiē nàtiáo qiǎn , shuǐdǐ de báishí xiàng yìqún jǐ zhe guòlù de yáng .
pairs.english: At noon they crossed a low ridge and a river suddenly appeared on the left, paler than the one at Reed Steps, its white bed-stones like sheep jostling along a road.
pairs.hanzi: 中午过了一段低岭，河忽然从左边露出来，颜色比苇阶那条浅，水底的白石像一群挤着过路的羊。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kàn dé jiǔ le , ruì shīfu wèn tā shìbushì tóuyìhuí jiàn hé . tā shuō búshì , shí yán shuō kàndéchūlái , tóuyìhuí jiàn de rén hái huì xiān wèn shìbushì dào le .
pairs.english: Tavi stared so long that Master Rui asked if this was his first river. He said no. Shiyan said he could tell: a first-timer would first ask whether they had arrived.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看得久了，芮师傅问他是不是头一回见河。他说不是，石延说看得出来，头一回见的人还会先问是不是到了。

pairs.target: tā lìjí wèn dào le méiyǒu , shí yán lèng le yíxià , liǎnggè rén dōu xiào . dào shí zhuó zhīqián , chē xiān jīngguò yìdǔ gāo dé chūqí de jiù qiáng .
pairs.english: He immediately asked whether they had arrived; Shiyan blinked, and both laughed. Before Stonewash, the cart passed an extraordinarily tall old wall.
pairs.hanzi:
他立即问到了没有，石延愣了一下，两个人都笑。
到石濯之前，车先经过一堵高得出奇的旧墙。

pairs.target: qiáng de xià bànjié mái zài pō lǐ , shàngmiàn pái zhe xǔduō xiá chuāng , yǒu de dǔzhù , yǒu de lù zhe hēikǒu .
pairs.english: The wall’s lower half was buried in the slope, rows of narrow windows above, some blocked and others opening black.
pairs.hanzi: 墙的下半截埋在坡里，上面排着许多狭窗，有的堵住，有的露着黑口。

pairs.target: zuì xià tóu jǐshàn rújīn zhī gòu rén dūn zhe kàn , chuāngqián què yǒurén liàng yīshang , huābù yìhuǎng , xiàng wūlǐ hái zhù zhe bǐ shānpō gāodà dé duō de rén .
pairs.english: The lowest windows could now only be viewed crouching, yet people dried clothes before them; a flutter of patterned cloth made it seem inhabitants far taller than the hillside still lived inside.
pairs.hanzi: 最下头几扇如今只够人蹲着看，窗前却有人晾衣裳，花布一晃，像屋里还住着比山坡高大得多的人。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rěnbúzhù huítóu . nài lěi cóngqián chē zhǐ le zhǐ qiángjiǎo , jiào tā kàn nà dào héng zhe de shēnhén . nà shì guòqù de gāo shuǐxiàn , tā shuō , zhǐshì zhèlǐ jiàn guò de yícì shuǐ gāo , búshì cóngcǐ búhuì zài gāo .
pairs.english: Tavi could not help looking back. From the lead cart Nerai pointed at a deep horizontal mark near the wall’s foot. An old high-water line, she said: one level reached here, no promise it would never rise higher.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维忍不住回头。奈蕾从前车指了指墙脚，叫他看那道横着的深痕。那是过去的高水线，她说，只是这里见过的一次水高，不是从此不会再高。

pairs.target: tā xiǎngxiàng shuǐ yìzhí zhǎng dào nàxiē chuāngqián , chēlǐ de rén , lùbiān de cài , gāngcái nà qún báishí dōu dé fàngdào nǎlǐ .
pairs.english: He imagined water rising to those windows; where would the cart passengers, roadside vegetables and white stones go?
pairs.hanzi: 他想象水一直涨到那些窗前，车里的人、路边的菜、刚才那群白石都得放到哪里。

pairs.target: gǎnchē rén què zài cǐshí dǎlegè xiǎngliàng de pēntì , shí yán shǒumángjiǎoluàn qù àn fēi qǐ de màozi , shìjiè yíxià yòu huídào zhèliàng yáohuàng de chēshàng .
pairs.english: Then the driver sneezed loudly, Shiyan scrambled to catch a flying hat, and the world abruptly returned to this rocking cart.
pairs.hanzi: 赶车人却在此时打了个响亮的喷嚏，石延手忙脚乱去按飞起的帽子，世界一下又回到这辆摇晃的车上。

pairs.target: xiū péng zài hé wān nèicè . xīn dā de zhuāngpèi tái kàozhe pō shàng de yán miàn , lí lǎo zhá nàbiān gé le yìtiáo suìshí dài hé liǎngdào mùlán .
pairs.english: The repair depot stood inside a river bend. Its new assembly platform rested against hillside bedrock, separated from the old sluice by a gravel strip and two wooden barriers.
pairs.hanzi: 修棚在河弯内侧。新搭的装配台靠着坡上的岩面，离老闸那边隔了一条碎石带和两道木栏。

pairs.target: ruì shīfu xiān qù kàntái jiǎo , zài tóng liúshǒu de rén héduì qián jǐtiān chá guò de géduàn . xiāngzǐ méiyǒu lìkè dǎkāi , xiān fàngdào gān dì .
pairs.english: Master Rui first checked the platform supports, then verified the recently inspected isolation with the caretaker. The cases were set on dry ground without being opened yet.
pairs.hanzi: 芮师傅先去看台脚，再同留守的人核对前几天查过的隔断。箱子没有立刻打开，先放到干地。

pairs.target: yígè xiùzǐ wǎn dé hěn gāo de nǚrén cóng ànbiān guòlái , wèn ruì shīfu míngtiān dàodǐ xiān zhuāng nǎ yìbiān , zìjǐ hǎo jiào rén bǎ kōngchuán nuókāi .
pairs.english: A woman with sleeves rolled high came from the bank and asked Master Rui which side they would assemble first tomorrow, so she could have the empty boats moved.
pairs.hanzi: 一个袖子挽得很高的女人从岸边过来，问芮师傅明天到底先装哪一边，自己好叫人把空船挪开。

pairs.target: tā jiào yuè qín , guǎn zhè chù xièhuò , bú zài gōng duìlǐ , què bǎ měigè rén míngtiān zhàn nǎlǐ de shì jìde bǐ tāmen hái láo .
pairs.english: Her name was Yueqin, and she managed unloading here, outside the work crew, yet remembered everyone’s space needs tomorrow better than they did.
pairs.hanzi: 她叫月芹，管这处卸货，不在工队里，却把每个人明天占哪里的事记得比他们还牢。

pairs.target: ruì shīfu zhǐ gěi tā kàn yào yòng de héàn , yuè qín lìkè shuō bùxíng , shǎngwǔ liǎng chuán yán dào , nàlǐ ruò bǎimǎn mùliào , tā zhǐnéng ràng rén bǎ dàizǐ yìbāo bāo bèishàng pō .
pairs.english: Master Rui showed her the bank they needed. Yueqin refused at once: two boatloads of salt would arrive at noon; if timber filled that space, people would have to carry the bags uphill one by one.
pairs.hanzi: 芮师傅指给她看要用的河岸，月芹立刻说不行，晌午两船盐到，那里若摆满木料，她只能让人把袋子一包包背上坡。

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén yánàn zǒu le yíbiàn , zuìhòu jiāng duī liào chù nuó dào péng hòu , zhuāngpèi tái bú dòng .
pairs.english: They walked the bank together, finally moving the timber storage behind the shed while leaving the assembly platform in place.
pairs.hanzi: 两个人沿岸走了一遍，最后将堆料处挪到棚后，装配台不动。

alignment.english: leaving the assembly platform in place

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǐwéi jiǎngwán le , yuè qín yòu wèn yǔpéng xià nà kǒu guō shì shuí yòng . shí yán shuō tāmen yě dé chīfàn , tā shuō dāngrán , kě bié bǎ xièhuò rén liú de rèshuǐ quán dǎo qù xǐ mùtou .
pairs.english: Tavi thought they were finished, but Yueqin asked who would use the pot under the awning. Shiyan said they had to eat too. Of course, she said, but do not use all the unloaders’ hot water to wash timber.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维以为讲完了，月芹又问雨棚下那口锅是谁用。石延说他们也得吃饭，她说当然，可别把卸货人留的热水全倒去洗木头。

pairs.target: " shàng huí shì shuí ? " ruì shīfu wèn . " búshì nǐ . gēn nǐ shuō le , xiàhuí jiù búbì zài zhǎo shì shuí . "
pairs.english: “Who did it last time?” Master Rui asked. “Not you. Tell you now, and next time we need not find out who.”
pairs.hanzi:
“上回是谁？”芮师傅问。
“不是你。跟你说了，下回就不必再找是谁。”

pairs.target: ruì shīfu dāying le , jiào shí yán jiāng xǐ wù tǒng lìngwài ná chūlái . yuè qín zhè cái zǒu , lùguò tǎ wéi shí kànkàn tā shǒulǐ de běnzi , wèn xiěxià méiyǒu . tā shuō xiě le guō , tā shuō hái dé xiě shuǐ búshì guō zìjǐ zhǔ de .
pairs.english: Master Rui agreed and had Shiyan fetch a separate washing bucket. Only then did Yueqin leave. Passing Tavi, she looked at his notebook and asked if he had written it down. He said the pot; she said to note that the pot did not boil water by itself either.
pairs.hanzi: 芮师傅答应了，叫石延将洗物桶另外拿出来。月芹这才走，路过塔维时看看他手里的本子，问写下没有。他说写了锅，她说还得写水不是锅自己煮的。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn tāmen bǎ xiāngzǐ bānjìn xīn táihòu de suǒ wū , tǎ wéi zhī tì shí yán fúzhù yìtóu , méiyǒu qù mō wéilán lǐ de jiù tiě jiàn .
pairs.english: At dusk they carried the cases into a locked room behind the new platform. Tavi only steadied one end for Shiyan, without touching the old iron inside the barriers.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚他们把箱子搬进新台后的锁屋，塔维只替石延扶住一头，没有去摸围栏里的旧铁件。

pairs.target: ruì shīfu ràng tā míng zǎoxiān tóng zìjǐ hé tái , bù jí zhe kāi zǎi , jīnwǎn qù rèn zhùwū hé chīfàn de dìfāng .
pairs.english: Master Rui told him to check the platform with her first tomorrow morning, without rushing to load it, and tonight to find the lodging and dining place.
pairs.hanzi: 芮师傅让他明早先同自己核台，不急着开载，今晚去认住屋和吃饭的地方。

pairs.target: zhùwū de chuāng zhèng duì gāoqiáng . yèsè xiàlái , jǐshàn hēi chuāng lǐ liàng qǐ xiǎoxiǎode dēng , báitiān nà kuài huābù yǐjīng shōu le , chuāngyán dǎo fàngchū yìzhī wǎn .
pairs.english: The lodging window faced the tall wall. At night, small lights appeared in its dark windows; the patterned cloth hung there by day had been taken in, but a bowl now sat on a sill.
pairs.hanzi: 住屋的窗正对高墙。夜色下来，几扇黑窗里亮起小小的灯，白天那块花布已经收了，窗沿倒放出一只碗。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng liǎngshuāng gān wà tāndào chuángtóu , hūrán hěn xiǎng ràng mǐlā kànjiàn , zìjǐ zhèhuí quèshí dài le . tā zài běnzi shàng xiě le yuè qín , rèshuǐ hé duī liào de wèizhì , yòu lìng liú bànyè huà qiáng . huà dào nàxiē dēng , tā cái fāxiàn , zìjǐ jīntiān hái méi wèn qiáng yuánlái shì shénme .
pairs.english: Tavi spread two pairs of dry socks by his bed, suddenly wishing Mira could see he really had brought them. He recorded Yueqin, hot water and the timber storage, leaving half a page for the wall. Drawing the lights, he realized he had not yet asked today what the wall had once been.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将两双干袜摊到床头，忽然很想让米拉看见，自己这回确实带了。他在本子上写了月芹、热水和堆料的位置，又另留半页画墙。画到那些灯，他才发现，自己今天还没问墙原来是什么。
